dispatch.evidence: Build 0488 ORIGINAL ARCADE timing plus Build 0489 death/respawn command-state proof

diagnostic_selection_doc: Reserved synthetic selectors in the arcade-ignored command range 0xC0-0xDF (the original
sound CPU dispatches only 0x00-0x2B as music and ignores 0x2C-0xDF), so the running game
never emits them and production behavior is unchanged.  They exist ONLY so an explicitly
every authored stream.  They are NOT authentic gameplay triggers; build/audio/
music_command_inventory.json records command->song as UNRESOLVED and no authentic BGM
command->song mapping other than the appearance-driven 0x25 is proven.  Do not present a
diagnostic selector as an authentic in-game music event.
unresolved_authentic_mappings_doc: Candidate authentic BGM commands observed by context but NOT corroborated against musical
content, therefore NOT wired into production dispatch:
- 0x04 emitted at the credit state (ORIGINAL ARCADE trace states/traces/audio015_arcade_gameover,
st0=1/st2=1 immediately after coin) is a 2-channel cue; candidate for '01 - Credit' but unproven.
Resolving these requires matching each command's installed sub-sequence register stream to the
captured .vgz identity (the AUDIO-002/AUDIO-009 command->song follow-up that remains open).
